trap.label: leitura
trap.wrong: The poem says that what can not be said can still be shaped.
trap.right: The poem says that what cannot be said can still be shaped.
trap.why: Em português “não pode” são duas palavras; em inglês a forma usual é cannot, numa só palavra.

mcq.q: Where to look for the central idea of a poem?
“What cannot be said can still be shaped” implies…

fix.wrong: What can not be said can be shaped.
fix.right: What cannot be said can be shaped.

fix.wrong: The poem is saying about silence.
He inferred from the end that.
fix.right: He inferred from the ending that…

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “Readers shape what cannot be said.”
rewrite.answer: What cannot be said is shaped by readers.
The poem does not say it.
